summary: Candidate is a knowledge_reference documenting Spring Boot 2.x → 3.0 instrumentation deprecations (WebMvcMetricsFilter, MetricsRestTemplateCustomizer, TagProvider, TagContributor migrations to Observation API). Peer candidates address different aspects of Spring Boot 3.0 migration (actuator class renames, system requirements validation, Jakarta EE package migration) but do not semantically overlap with instrumentation-specific deprecation mapping. Existing skills are unrelated (cache eviction principles, virtual hub routing). Candidate has explicit support from Spring Boot 3.0 Migration Guide and fills a distinct knowledge gap in the migration reference layer.
